# Theme license notices

The theme chooser loads Shiki theme bundles through the existing `@pierre/diffs` dependency. Application colors are derived from the selected bundle's editor colors; no separate theme repository is copied into this application.

`LICENSE` and `NOTICE` are preserved verbatim from the published `tm-themes@1.12.12` package, the source theme package declared by `@shikijs/themes@4.5.0`. The complete notice covers all themes bundled by Shiki, including themes not exposed by the chooser. Preserve both files in distributed builds.

Source package: https://registry.npmjs.org/tm-themes/-/tm-themes-1.12.12.tgz

Upstream source: https://github.com/shikijs/textmate-grammars-themes/tree/main/packages/tm-themes

Package integrity (verified when copied): `sha512-okyxQlASpDOtUA40+ZT0IGQyfObGOknntHY3kujfUlD8lj3ERMObDJNRgvlc/baVMsnJVQmtAB2nE7LFGTo0qQ==`

When updating Shiki, verify its theme source version and refresh these notices together.
